Frozen Max for Live devices saved by Max, used only as read-only test inputs for m4l/tools/amxd_frozen.py
(the writer must reproduce them byte for byte). Both are MIT licensed by Ableton AG:

* OSC MIDI Send.amxd   from https://github.com/Ableton/m4l-connection-kit (frozen by Max 8.0; 5 embedded files)
* WithGarbage.amxd     from https://github.com/Ableton/maxdevtools, maxdiff/tests/test_files (frozen by Max 8.1; 1 file)
